statement: Andy Biggs wins the Arizona gubernatorial general election, defeating Katie Hobbs by any margin, with results certified between 2026-11-05 and 2026-12-15
resolution: The Arizona Secretary of State certified election results list Andy Biggs as the winner of the 2026 gubernatorial election by any vote margin

statement: At least one major social media platform (Meta, TikTok, Snap, or X) publicly announces an age-verification mechanism for French users between 2026-07-23 and 2026-10-31
resolution: A company press release, official blog post, or two independent wire reports confirm a named platform announcing age verification for France in the window

statement: The Japan Meteorological Agency issues heatstroke or extreme-heat alerts covering Tokyo or Osaka on at least five separate days between 2026-07-23 and 2026-08-20
resolution: JMA official alert records or two independent wire reports confirm five or more distinct alert days for either city in the window

statement: At least two independent wire services report a new United States or Israeli military strike on Iranian territory or Iranian-flagged maritime assets between 2026-07-23 and 2026-09-15
resolution: Two or more of Reuters, AP, AFP, BBC, or Al Jazeera publish reports of a new strike on Iranian territory or Iranian-flagged vessels dated within the window

statement: Brent crude front-month settles above 90 dollars per barrel on at least three trading days between 2026-07-23 and 2026-08-14
resolution: ICE Brent front-month official settlement prices exceed 90 dollars on three or more weekdays within the window per exchange or EIA data

statement: The United States 10-year Treasury yield closes above 4.80 percent on at least one trading day between 2026-07-23 and 2026-09-30
resolution: US Treasury daily yield curve data or Bloomberg records show a 10-year constant maturity closing yield above 4.80 percent on any day in the window
